note: Set B is better because it correctly extracts title block metadata (revisions, drawn by) which Set A misses entirely. Set A contains OCR errors ('CONT. BE' instead of 'CONT. BENT') and factual dimension errors (claiming 1/4" thickness for 3/8" support plates). Both sets struggle with binding specific annotations to the correct detail view (e.g., attributing C5 text to A4), but Set B has fewer direct misreads of the text layer and more accurate member size extractions, despite incorrectly interpreting the drawing scale as reinforcement spacing.
